# 中文

## 设计原因

本 PR 由只读 GitHub 发现任务生成，用于把 DSH 相关公开仓库整理成待审核候选，减少仅靠人工记忆寻找插件造成的遗漏。

## 作用与预期效果

候选先按可验证证据等级排序，再在同一等级内按 star 排序并执行可配置分位抽样；结果保存查询条件、固定 commit、`package.json` 和同目录 `dsh-plugin.naming.json` 的证据。维护者可以据此优先审核高可信度、高可见度项目，而不下载或执行第三方代码。

## 安全边界

候选不会预留 ID，也不会进入正式冲突判定。只有带固定来源证明、完整上下文并经人工批准的登记 PR 才能写入 `registry/entries/`。Star 只用于安排检查顺序，不代表质量、安全性或兼容性。

## 验证

自动任务在推送候选分支前运行仓库测试和正式索引校验；候选分支随后单独触发必需的验证工作流。

---

# English

## Design Rationale

This PR is generated by the read-only GitHub discovery job. It turns public DSH-related repositories into a review queue and reduces omissions caused by relying on manual discovery alone.

## Purpose And Expected Effect

Candidates are ranked by verifiable evidence first and by stars within each evidence tier, then selected through a configurable percentile. The result retains the queries, immutable commit, `package.json`, and colocated `dsh-plugin.naming.json` evidence. Maintainers can prioritize higher-confidence, more visible projects without downloading or executing third-party code.

## Security Boundary

Candidates do not reserve IDs and do not participate in formal conflict decisions. Only a registration PR with pinned source proof, complete context, and human approval may enter `registry/entries/`. Stars prioritize inspection; they do not prove quality, safety, or compatibility.

## Verification

The automation runs repository tests and formal-index validation before pushing the candidate branch, then separately dispatches the required validation workflow for that branch.
